findings.review: Five connected bastions, surrounding ditches and separate ravelins read as a compact Vauban fortress. Natural muted brick, stone and grass colors; no global blue cast. Recognizable star-fort silhouette at 48/64 pixels.
findings.limits: Conceptual Lille-inspired architecture, not an exact plan or archaeological reconstruction. Very small masonry details necessarily disappear at 32 pixels.

findings.review: Two brass arms joined at a visible upper pivot; dark iron tips surround a single cannonball. Clear connected inspection concept, subdued metal texture, no text.
findings.limits: Simplified gunner's-caliper interpretation, not an exact copy of the inscribed museum instrument.

findings.review: Exactly three attached tripod legs; board, central mounting joint, brass straightedge and two attached sighting vanes are coherent. Nearly-white drawing sheet and natural warm wood; no blue cast.
findings.limits: Map strokes become faint at small sizes; board/tripod silhouette and sighting instrument remain readable.
